import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap

# =============================================================================
# POWER BI DATA INPUT
# =============================================================================
# Power BI creates ''dataset'' DataFrame from fields in Values well
#
# For local testing, uncomment below:
# dataset = pd.read_csv(''GM_Risk.csv'')
# =============================================================================

df = dataset.copy()

# =============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =============================================================================
FIGURE_WIDTH = 12
FIGURE_HEIGHT = 9
BASE_BUBBLE_SIZE = 180
BUBBLE_SCALE_FACTOR = 14
JITTER_STRENGTH = 0.12

# Fallback colors if Risk_Color column not available
RISK_COLORS_FALLBACK = {
    ''Critical'': ''#FF0000'',
    ''Medium'': ''#FFE66D'',
    ''Low'': ''#4ECDC4''
}

# Heatmap background gradient
HEATMAP_COLORS = [''#2ECC71'', ''#F1C40F'', ''#E67E22'', ''#E74C3C'', ''#C0392B'']

# =============================================================================
# CREATE VISUALIZATION
# =============================================================================

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FIGURE_WIDTH, FIGURE_HEIGHT))

# Build 5x5 risk matrix background
risk_matrix = np.array([
    [5, 10, 15, 20, 25],   # Impact = 5
    [4,  8, 12, 16, 20],   # Impact = 4
    [3,  6,  9, 12, 15],   # Impact = 3
    [2,  4,  6,  8, 10],   # Impact = 2
    [1,  2,  3,  4,  5]    # Impact = 1
])

# Create colormap and plot background
cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(''risk'', HEATMAP_COLORS, N=100)
im = ax.imshow(risk_matrix, cmap=cmap, aspect=''auto'',
               extent=[0.5, 5.5, 0.5, 5.5], alpha=0.55, vmin=1, vmax=25)

# Add grid lines
for i in range(1, 6):
    ax.axhline(y=i + 0.5, color=''white'', linewidth=2.5)
    ax.axvline(x=i + 0.5, color=''white'', linewidth=2.5)

# =============================================================================
# PLOT RISK BUBBLES
# =============================================================================

np.random.seed(42)

for idx, row in df.iterrows():
    # Position with jitter
    x = row[''Likelihood''] + np.random.uniform(-JITTER_STRENGTH, JITTER_STRENGTH)
    y = row[''Impact''] + np.random.uniform(-JITTER_STRENGTH, JITTER_STRENGTH)
    
    # Bubble size based on mentions
    size = BASE_BUBBLE_SIZE + (row[''Mentions''] * BUBBLE_SCALE_FACTOR)
    
    # Use Risk_Color from data if available, otherwise fallback
    if ''Risk_Color'' in df.columns and pd.notna(row[''Risk_Color'']):
        color = row[''Risk_Color'']
    else:
        color = RISK_COLORS_FALLBACK.get(row[''Risk_Level''], ''#888888'')
    
    # Plot bubble with white border
    ax.scatter(x, y, s=size, c=color, edgecolors=''white'',
               linewidths=2.5, alpha=0.9, zorder=5)
    
    # Add Risk_ID label
    ax.annotate(row[''Risk_ID''], (x, y),
                fontsize=9, fontweight=''bold'', color=''white'',
                ha=''center'', va=''center'', zorder=6)

# =============================================================================
# FORMAT AXES
# =============================================================================

ax.set_xlim(0.5, 5.5)
ax.set_ylim(0.5, 5.5)
ax.set_xticks([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
ax.set_yticks([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])

# Use Likelihood_Label and Impact_Label if available
if ''Likelihood_Label'' in df.columns:
    # Extract unique labels for x-axis
    x_labels = [''1 - Very Low'', ''2 - Low'', ''3 - Medium'', ''4 - High'', ''5 - Very High'']
else:
    x_labels = [''1\nVery Low'', ''2\nLow'', ''3\nMedium'', ''4\nHigh'', ''5\nVery High'']

if ''Impact_Label'' in df.columns:
    y_labels = [''1 - Very Low'', ''2 - Low'', ''3 - Medium'', ''4 - High'', ''5 - Very High'']
else:
    y_labels = [''1\nVery Low'', ''2\nLow'', ''3\nMedium'', ''4\nHigh'', ''5\nVery High'']

ax.set_xticklabels(x_labels, fontsize=10)
ax.set_yticklabels(y_labels, fontsize=10)

ax.set_xlabel(''LIKELIHOOD'', fontsize=13, fontweight=''bold'', labelpad=12)
ax.set_ylabel(''IMPACT'', fontsize=13, fontweight=''bold'', labelpad=12)
ax.set_title(''Stellantis N.V. FY 2025\nEnterprise Risk Assessment Matrix'',
             fontsize=15, fontweight=''bold'', pad=18)

# =============================================================================
# QUADRANT LABELS
# =============================================================================

ax.text(1.5, 5.3, ''Low Likelihood\nHigh Impact'', fontsize=9, fontstyle=''italic'',
        ha=''center'', color=''#444444'', alpha=0.85)
ax.text(4.5, 5.3, ''CRITICAL\nZONE'', fontsize=10, fontweight=''bold'',
        ha=''center'', color=''#C0392B'')
ax.text(1.5, 0.7, ''Low Priority'', fontsize=9, fontstyle=''italic'',
        ha=''center'', color=''#444444'', alpha=0.85)
ax.text(4.5, 0.7, ''High Likelihood\nLow Impact'', fontsize=9, fontstyle=''italic'',
        ha=''center'', color=''#444444'', alpha=0.85)

# =============================================================================
# LEGEND
# =============================================================================

legend_elements = [
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=''#FF0000'', edgecolor=''white'', label=''Critical''),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=''#FFE66D'', edgecolor=''white'', label=''Medium''),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=''#4ECDC4'', edgecolor=''white'', label=''Low''),
]

legend = ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, 
                   loc=''upper left'',
                   bbox_to_anchor=(1.01, 1.0),
                   title=''Risk Level'', 
                   framealpha=0.95, 
                   fontsize=11,
                   title_fontsize=12,
                   borderaxespad=0)

# =============================================================================
# COLORBAR
# =============================================================================

cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, shrink=0.55, pad=0.02)
cbar.set_label(''Risk Score (Likelihood × Impact)'', fontsize=10, labelpad=10)

# =============================================================================
# FOOTNOTE
# =============================================================================

ax.text(0.98, 0.02, ''Bubble size = 20-F Item 3.D mention frequency'',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=9, ha=''right'', va=''bottom'',
        style=''italic'', color=''#555555'',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle=''round'', facecolor=''white'', alpha=0.85, edgecolor=''#cccccc''))

# Summary stats
total_risks = len(df)
critical_count = len(df[df[''Risk_Level''] == ''Critical''])
ax.text(0.02, 0.02, f''Total Risks: {total_risks}  |  Critical: {critical_count}'',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=9, ha=''left'', va=''bottom'',
        color=''#555555'',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle=''round'', facecolor=''white'', alpha=0.85, edgecolor=''#cccccc''))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()'
